name: MiniMax H3 — text to image
description:
A still picture from MiniMax H3 — the video-and-sound model, asked for a single frame.

Because it was trained on film, it is strong at cinematic framing, light and atmosphere: write the picture the way a director of photography would describe a shot — subject, setting, lens and angle, light, colour palette, medium.

Fast mode (on) uses the 8-step turbo LoRA. Turn it off for the base model at the steps below (30 by default, up to 50 for the most detail) — about four times slower.

It loads a 20 GB model plus a 15 GB text encoder, so the first picture after a model change takes a while; it owns the card on a 32 GB GPU.

promptGuides.label: MiniMax H3 — official prompt guide
promptGuides.tip: Describe it like a film frame: subject, setting, lens and angle, light and palette. H3 keeps improving with more steps.

exposedParameters.label: Prompt
exposedParameters.default: Epic sci-fi concept art, extreme low-angle wide shot of a colossal spacecraft hovering above a sandstorm-ravaged desert. The open hangar glows furnace-orange through dense blowing dust and volumetric light shafts. A long boarding ramp descends to the dunes; a lone human climbs it, wind-whipped sand swirling around their ankles, tiny against the massive hull. Low amber sun behind the craft casts a hard silhouette and long god-rays across ochre and rust dunes. Distant convoy lights glimmer on the horizon. Monumental scale, cinematic digital illustration, ultra-detailed metal plating and dust particles, desert palette of ochre, rust, and ember orange, dramatic rim light, sharp focus, no text, no watermark.
